ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, if the seal population declined, what would happen to the killer whale population?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In this food web diagram, on the left side there are two nodes, "Killer Whales" and "Seals", and there is a direct food relationship arrow between them, indicating that seals are one of the food sources in the killer whale food web relationship. Reasoning: The question asks what will happen to the number of killer whales if the number of seals declines. Because killer whales feed on seals, a decrease in seals will reduce the food available to killer whales, so the killer whale population will also decline.
